_comment: Function-coverage floors from issue #111. A module may not be migrated in Phase 3 until it clears its floor - the lock suite has to have executed the code before it is restructured. Keyed by basename, so a floor keeps applying after Phase 3 moves the file; when a migration renames the file, the key moves with the logic, or the floor silently starts measuring the delegating shim left behind. See issue #111.
